summary: Verified BDS Marvel post-import: home page loads, hero+scrolling panel sections (network, experience spotlight, clients marquee, purpose, contact CTA, footer) all render; all inner routes /about /projects /catalogue /experience /contact respond 200; contact modal submits successfully -> success confirmation shown; backend persists inquiry (verified via GET /api/inquiries) and dispatches Resend email (HTTP 202) with 'Inquiry notification emailed to delivered@resend.dev' logged; validation for invalid email / short message / missing fields returns 422 and modal shows inline error.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~971 lines and combines routing, contact modal, sections, and data — consider splitting into components/pages for maintainability.

send_email raises HTTPException on failure but create_inquiry catches broadly; user still gets 201 which is intentional but backend just logs failure. Consider surfacing an inquiry-level status or metric.
GET /api/inquiries has no auth — publicly exposes submitted names/emails/messages (privacy concern). Recommend adding auth or removing from public API in production.
InquiryCreate accepts EmailStr but does not require pydantic[email]; ensure email-validator remains in requirements (currently works).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed inquiries via API/UI in mongo `test_database.inquiries` (should be cleaned up manually if desired).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_inquiries.py covers valid+minimal create, invalid email, short message, missing fields, list sort desc, root health. UI contact form testids: contact-name-input, contact-email-input, contact-company-input, contact-agency-select, contact-budget-select, contact-message-input, contact-modal-submit, contact-modal-success, contact-modal-error. Triggers: contact-section-cta on homepage, or network-panel-N-contact / experience-spotlight-request. GET /api/inquiries currently public — flag if security surfaces.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Only pre-existing broad concerns noted under code review comments.
